components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Advances an event or account action with the indigo accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:16px; min-height:44px; padding:10px 15px; border:1px solid var(--brand); border-radius:8px; background:var(--brand); color:#fff; font:500 14px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--brand-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a78bed; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.48; }

components.name: Neutral Control
components.description: Native secondary action used for controls, receipts, and fallback paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-control { min-height:44px; padding:10px 15px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); font:500 14px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .16s ease,box-shadow .16s ease; } .ds-btn-control:hover:not(:disabled) { background:var(--subtle); } .ds-btn-control:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a78bed; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-control:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.48; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Labelled native field for event and account data.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; color:var(--ink); font:500 13px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display:block; width:100%; min-height:46px; margin-top:8px; padding:11px 12px; border:1px solid #cbc5da; border-radius:8px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); font:400 14px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; caret-color:var(--brand); } .ds-field input::placeholder { color:#7a7389; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a78bed; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Event Card
components.description: Compact event-list item showing id, amount, and phase.
components.css: .ds-event-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:flex-start; gap:4px; width:100%; min-height:140px; padding:17px 18px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); text-align:left; font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-event-card:hover { background:var(--subtle); } .ds-event-card:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a78bed; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-event-card strong { margin:3px 0; font-size:13px; } .ds-event-card span,.ds-event-card small,.ds-event-card em { font-size:11px; font-style:normal; color:var(--muted); } .ds-event-card em { margin-top:7px; font-size:10px; }

components.name: Event Workspace
components.description: White bounded workspace for phase, event facts, and personal action.
components.css: .ds-workspace-card { min-height:240px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 8px 36px #33225105; } .ds-workspace-card h2 { margin:0; padding:26px 29px 9px; font:600 22px/1.4 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-workspace-card h2 span { color:#8b809d; font-weight:400; } .ds-workspace-card p { margin:0; padding:0 29px 18px; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-workspace-rule { border-top:1px solid var(--line); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Desktop top bar for language and wallet controls; the shell hides the rail on smaller widths.
components.css: .ds-top-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; min-height:88px; padding:0 42px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); background:#fff; color:var(--muted); font:400 13px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; } .ds-top-nav > div { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; } .ds-top-nav button { min-height:44px; padding:8px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); font:500 12px/1.6 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-top-nav button[aria-pressed="true"] { background:var(--subtle); color:var(--brand); font-weight:600; } .ds-top-nav .ds-wallet { border:1px solid var(--line); padding:10px 15px; color:var(--ink); } .ds-top-nav button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #a78bed; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Event Phase Rail
components.description: Three-stage lifecycle marker for registration, check-in, and closing.
components.html:
1. Registration12 Jun, 18:00
  2. 2Check-in12 Jun, 19:00
components.css: .ds-phase-rail { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:22px; margin:0; padding:0; list-style:none; font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; } .ds-phase-rail li { display:grid; grid-template-columns:24px 1fr; column-gap:12px; align-items:start; color:var(--muted); } .ds-phase-rail li > span { display:grid; place-items:center; width:24px; height:24px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:50%; color:var(--muted); font-size:11px; } .ds-phase-rail li.reached > span { border-color:var(--success); color:var(--success); } .ds-phase-rail strong,.ds-phase-rail time { grid-column:2; } .ds-phase-rail strong { font-size:13px; color:var(--ink); } .ds-phase-rail time { margin-top:3px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); }

components.name: Personal Status Panel
components.description: Separate account state and action panel that stacks below the event on phones.
components.html:
Your status

components.css: .ds-personal-panel { min-width:0; padding:26px 20px; border-left:1px solid var(--line); background:#faf9fd; color:var(--ink); font-family:'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif; } .ds-personal-panel h3 { margin:0 0 20px; font-size:13px; } .ds-personal-panel .ds-state { display:flex; gap:7px; align-items:center; margin:20px 0; color:var(--brand); font-size:11px; } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-personal-panel { padding:25px 22px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-left:0; } }

narrative.overview:
CommitPot is an Operate surface: a compact, code-led workspace that makes an event commitment legible before a wallet prompt. The incumbent build translates the student-association direction into a saturated indigo rail, white working surfaces, cool lilac context, dark ink, and a restrained status vocabulary. No images or reference compositions are adopted; the interface earns identity through event phases, exact amounts, native controls, and receipts.

The density is workhorse rather than decorative. A visible phase rail carries the lifecycle from registration through check-in to settlement, while the personal status panel keeps account action distinct from shared event facts. English and Vietnamese use the same local Be Vietnam Pro family and the same measured hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo brand rail with white and cool-lilac work surfaces.
State-first event lifecycle and exact Test USDC amounts.
Compact readable density with native labelled controls.
Personal status/action panel that stacks below the event workspace on phones.

rules.name: The State-First Rule
rules.body: Use color to reinforce a known lifecycle or account state; never let decoration outrank the event phase or exact amount.

rules.name: The Indigo Anchor Rule
rules.body: Keep saturated indigo concentrated in brand navigation, primary action, and active state roles against quiet working surfaces.

rules.name: The Workhorse Sans Rule
rules.body: Keep the local Be Vietnam Pro family for all UI copy, including translated labels and account addresses; do not introduce a decorative display face.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer tonal layering and borders at rest; shadows remain low-opacity and structural rather than expressive.

dos: Do keep the indigo, white, cool-lilac, dark-ink palette and use semantic green/crimson only for confirmed status or errors.
Do preserve Be Vietnam Pro local font files and the same hierarchy for EN and VI.
Do keep native labelled controls, minimum 44px buttons, 46px fields, visible keyboard focus, and the reduced-motion behavior already implemented.
Do keep exact deposit amounts, event phase, and personal status ahead of decorative treatment.
Do preserve the phone sidepanel stack: event facts first, personal status/action second.
donts: Don't add trading-dashboard decoration, yield imagery, ticket-paper costume, or adopted reference compositions.
Don't treat a small desktop label sizing/fit defect as a normative rule; it remains a finish-review item, not a token.
Don't claim accessibility certification from the observed focus, native-control, or reduced-motion rules; the final finish verdict accepts only the two scoped receipt/density corrections.
Don't replace native controls with glyph-only or unlabeled visual affordances.
